computation: the complete three-client fixed16 linear update and weighted aggregate from numeric-contract-v1.json
witness: independent secret 32-byte model and data blindings
hiding_assumption: computational hiding in the random-oracle model with independent uniform secret 256-bit blindings; collision resistance alone does not establish hiding
binding_assumption: SHA-256 collision resistance plus the proof/extraction and trusted-setup assumptions
randomness_policy: fresh OS entropy for each opening and proof; fail closed on entropy failure; never publish/reuse blindings; no secure-erasure guarantee
public_input_order: private-contract-domain-Fr, 32 context digest byte fields, 32 model commitment byte fields, 32 data commitment byte fields, three count fields, signed output field
state_scope: single-process one-transition consume-once reference; no persistent rollback protection, multiworker consensus, authentication or authorization service
